name: PROSTATEx: Prostate Cancer MRI Assessment Challenge
description: The PROSTATEx Challenge dataset is a public multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) benchmark hosted on The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) in collaboration with SPIE, AAPM, and NCI. Curated from examinations performed at Radboud University Medical Center in Nijmegen, Netherlands, the dataset features 346 mpMRI exams from 345 patients acquired on 3T Siemens scanners. Imaging modalities include transverse T2-weighted turbo spin-echo, apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps, high b-value diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), and dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) MRI series. Each patient case provides 3D spatial coordinate centroids of confirmed prostate lesions coupled with histopathology-proven clinically significant prostate cancer binary ground truth (Gleason score >= 7).
